# TorBox TypeScript SDK

TypeScript/JavaScript client for the [TorBox API](https://api-docs.torbox.app). Generated from the
[OpenAPI spec](https://api.torbox.app/openapi.json) and published automatically when the API changes.

```bash
npm install @torbox/torbox-api@9.3.1-20261125.4
```

Node 20+, Deno, Bun and browsers (uses `fetch`). ESM and CommonJS.

## Quick start

```ts
import { TorBox } from '@torbox/torbox-api';

const client = new TorBox({ apiKey: process.env.TORBOX_API_KEY! });   // https://torbox.app/settings
const me = await client.user.getUserData();                          // returns `data`, typed
console.log(me.email);

await client.torrents.createTorrent({ magnet: 'magnet:?xt=urn:btih:...' });
await client.torrents.createTorrent({ file: new Blob([await readFile('ubuntu.torrent')]) });
```

Groups: `torrents`, `usenet`, `webDownloads`, `user`, `general`, `notifications`, `rss`, `integrations`, `queued`,
`stream`, `tags`, `assistant`, `vendors`. Methods are the camelCase `operationId`s of the
[reference](https://api-docs.torbox.app/reference) and take one object of parameters.

## Authentication

The key is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The download link endpoints (`request*DownloadLink*`) take it as
the `token` query parameter: the client fills it in for you.

```ts
const url = await client.torrents.requestTorrentDownloadLink({ torrent_id: 123, file_id: 0 });
```

## Pagination

```ts
for await (const t of client.paginate((p) => client.torrents.getTorrentList(p), 100)) {
  console.log(t.id, t.name);
}
```

## Errors

Methods return `data` of the `{success, error, detail, data}` envelope and throw `TorBoxError` otherwise:

```ts
import { TorBoxError } from '@torbox/torbox-api';

try {
  await client.torrents.createTorrent({ magnet: '...' });
} catch (e) {
  if (e instanceof TorBoxError) console.log(e.status, e.error, e.detail); // 403 PLAN_RESTRICTED_FEATURE ...
}
```

Request validation errors (`422`) have `error === 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`. Error codes:
[api-docs.torbox.app/docs/errors](https://api-docs.torbox.app/docs/errors).

## Retries and timeouts

`429` and `503` are retried (default 3 times), waiting for `Retry-After` or backing off exponentially. Each attempt
times out after 30 s by default.

```ts
new TorBox({ apiKey, timeoutMs: 10_000, maxRetries: 5, baseUrl: 'https://api.torbox.app', fetch: myFetch });
await client.user.getUserData({}, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60_000) }); // per call
```

## Raw access

`client.torrents.getTorrentListRaw(...)` returns the `ApiResponse` (status, headers, envelope) without unwrapping.
